skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, trends, and impacts of international economic integration.
Understand the objectives, functions, and principles of the World Trade Organization (WTO), European Union, and ASEAN Economic Community.
Analyze the impact of trade agreements on Vietnam and other countries.
Apply knowledge to recognize and analyze the impact of international economic integration on countries, industries, and businesses.
Work independently and in groups to solve academic and professional tasks.
Develop self-learning skills, have a clear understanding of personal responsibilities, and actively solve assigned tasks.
Prepare and present group reports and effectively communicate findings.
Conduct research, gather data, and analyze information related to international economic integration.
